Game Overview

In Cat named Soko, the core idea is straightforward: guide Soko, the feline with a purpose, through cleverly designed grids in a delightful puzzle adventure. Strategically push balls into pockets while dodging tricky walls. With each level requiring careful thinking and foresight, embrace the challenge and help Soko navigate this quirky, minimalist world.
